# Davy Keith

## Overview

- **Age:** Seven (Volume 2)  <sub>[v2 c1 P31](../source/v02-c01.md#nw-v02-c01-p0031), [v2 c7 P28](../source/v02-c07.md#nw-v02-c07-p0028)</sub>
- **Gender:** Male  <sub>[v1 c1 P23](../source/v01-c01.md#nw-v01-c01-p0023), [v2 c1 P6](../source/v02-c01.md#nw-v02-c01-p0006)</sub>
- **Status:** Orphan; ward of Marilla Cuthbert  <sub>[v1 c1 P23](../source/v01-c01.md#nw-v01-c01-p0023), [v2 c7 P25](../source/v02-c07.md#nw-v02-c07-p0025), [v2 c22 P22](../source/v02-c22.md#nw-v02-c22-p0022)</sub>
- **Origin:** East Grafton, Prince Edward Island  <sub>[v2 c7 P23](../source/v02-c07.md#nw-v02-c07-p0023), [v2 c8 P0](../source/v02-c08.md#nw-v02-c08-p0000)</sub>
- **Role:** Student  <sub>[v2 c21 P0](../source/v02-c21.md#nw-v02-c21-p0000)</sub>
- **Nicknames:** Davy-boy  <sub>[v2 c16 P4](../source/v02-c16.md#nw-v02-c16-p0004)</sub>; Mr. Davy Keith  <sub>[v2 c8 P11](../source/v02-c08.md#nw-v02-c08-p0011)</sub>

## Appearance

Davy is a handsome, chubby boy with a crop of fuzzy little yellow ringlets all over his round head and roguish, dancing hazel eyes. He has a snub nose, a smiling mouth, and a comical, lopsided look due to a dimple in only one cheek. He is broader and stouter than his twin sister, Dora, and has a tendency to get extremely dirty.

_Sources: [v2 c1 P33](../source/v02-c01.md#nw-v02-c01-p0033), [v2 c8 P11](../source/v02-c08.md#nw-v02-c08-p0011), [v2 c8 P25](../source/v02-c08.md#nw-v02-c08-p0025), [v2 c8 P44](../source/v02-c08.md#nw-v02-c08-p0044)_

## Personality

Davy is an inquisitive, mischievous, and highly energetic child who has a passion for perpetual motion. He is extremely frank, loves badinage, and is constantly asking questions because he is curious about how the world works. Although he frequently gets into trouble due to a lack of early discipline, he possesses a warm, affectionate heart and a winning charm that easily earns him forgiveness. He idolizes Anne Shirley and expresses his feelings through impulsive hugs and caresses.

_Sources: [v2 c1 P33](../source/v02-c01.md#nw-v02-c01-p0033), [v2 c8 P2](../source/v02-c08.md#nw-v02-c08-p0002), [v2 c8 P4](../source/v02-c08.md#nw-v02-c08-p0004), [v2 c8 P10](../source/v02-c08.md#nw-v02-c08-p0010), [v2 c8 P14](../source/v02-c08.md#nw-v02-c08-p0014), [v2 c10 P53](../source/v02-c10.md#nw-v02-c10-p0053), [v2 c10 P89](../source/v02-c10.md#nw-v02-c10-p0089)_

## History

Davy Keith and his twin sister Dora were born in East Grafton. After their father died when they were babies, their mother raised them while suffering from a long illness, leaving Davy with very little proper upbringing. Following his mother's death, Marilla Cuthbert agreed to take the twins into Green Gables for the winter until their uncle in British Columbia could take them. Davy immediately proved to be a handful for Marilla and Anne Shirley, constantly engaging in antics such as dropping a caterpillar down a girl's dress in church, forcing his sister into a pigpen, and putting a toad in Marilla's bed. Despite his wild behavior, he developed a deep bond with Anne, who strove to teach him moral lessons, including the wickedness of lying. Over time, Davy's conduct gradually improved as he began attending school in Avonlea and befriended his classmate Milty Boulter. When his uncle died, a trust fund was left for Davy and Dora, allowing them to remain permanently at Green Gables under the care of Marilla, Anne, and Mrs. Rachel Lynde.

_Sources: [v2 c1 P29](../source/v02-c01.md#nw-v02-c01-p0029), [v2 c1 P33](../source/v02-c01.md#nw-v02-c01-p0033), [v2 c7 P25](../source/v02-c07.md#nw-v02-c07-p0025), [v2 c8 P0](../source/v02-c08.md#nw-v02-c08-p0000), [v2 c8 P36](../source/v02-c08.md#nw-v02-c08-p0036), [v2 c8 P49](../source/v02-c08.md#nw-v02-c08-p0049), [v2 c8 P60](../source/v02-c08.md#nw-v02-c08-p0060), [v2 c10 P53](../source/v02-c10.md#nw-v02-c10-p0053), [v2 c10 P55](../source/v02-c10.md#nw-v02-c10-p0055), [v2 c21 P0](../source/v02-c21.md#nw-v02-c21-p0000), [v2 c21 P1](../source/v02-c21.md#nw-v02-c21-p0001), [v2 c22 P22](../source/v02-c22.md#nw-v02-c22-p0022)_

## Background by volume

- Orphaned at a young age when his mother, Mary Keith, died of a long illness  <sub>[v2 c1 P29](../source/v02-c01.md#nw-v02-c01-p0029), [v2 c1 P33](../source/v02-c01.md#nw-v02-c01-p0033), [v2 c8 P8](../source/v02-c08.md#nw-v02-c08-p0008)</sub>
- Has a twin sister named Dora  <sub>[v2 c1 P31](../source/v02-c01.md#nw-v02-c01-p0031), [v2 c8 P0](../source/v02-c08.md#nw-v02-c08-p0000)</sub>
- Lived in East Grafton until his mother's death, receiving little upbringing or discipline  <sub>[v2 c1 P33](../source/v02-c01.md#nw-v02-c01-p0033), [v2 c7 P32](../source/v02-c07.md#nw-v02-c07-p0032), [v2 c8 P0](../source/v02-c08.md#nw-v02-c08-p0000)</sub>
- Inherited two thousand dollars in trust upon the death of his uncle Richard Keith  <sub>[v2 c22 P22](../source/v02-c22.md#nw-v02-c22-p0022)</sub>
